history.body: Hi, I work around Perai and saw your Seberang Jaya ad. Is this location convenient for daily travel?

Seberang Jaya may be a practical location for work around Perai, with connections toward Butterworth and the wider mainland urban network. The actual commute depends on which part of Perai you work in, so I wouldn’t want to guess a travel time. Which area is your workplace in?
It’s around central Perai, near the main commercial area. I’m mostly trying to get a feel for the commute and monthly costs.

For central Perai, Seberang Jaya has connections toward Butterworth and the wider mainland network, though I wouldn’t guess an exact commute time without a route-specific check. The Type A is 900 sq ft, and maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft including sinking fund—about RM162 a month. That’s separate from the loan instalment, which depends on the current unit price and financing terms. Are you looking to include the loan instalment in your monthly-cost estimate too?
That location sounds convenient. Before arranging a viewing, could you give me a rough idea of the monthly costs on top of the instalment?

The verified monthly charge I can give you is RM162 for maintenance, including the sinking fund (900 sq ft × RM0.18). The clubhouse is pay-per-use rather than a fixed monthly fee. Utilities depend on usage, and I don’t have a verified figure for any other mandatory recurring charges, so I wouldn’t want to guess at a total. I’ll check whether there are any additional fixed charges so you can assess the monthly picture before deciding about a viewing.
